title: Lipschitz Equivalent Separable Banach Spaces Need Not Be Linearly Isomorphic
summary: There are separable real Banach spaces that are globally bi-Lipschitz equivalent but not linearly isomorphic. This gives a negative answer to the separable Banach-space Lipschitz-isomorphism problem.
family_title: Lipschitz equivalent Banach spaces need not be linearly isomorphic

review.reason: Constructs separable Banach spaces that are bi-Lipschitz equivalent but not linearly isomorphic.
